# Preserve comm lint wrapper routing when removing setup hooks

The 1771 port removed separate setup hooks as lint requirements moved to Gecko site configuration. At the accepted endpoint codespell and ruff still route through commlint:lint_wrapper; the wrapper substitutes the wrapped payload and can set the root to comm. black.yml is absent in the bounded current tree. Treat the historical dependency consolidation separately from the retained comm wrapper; paired Gecko environment setup and lint execution are unverified. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: tools/lint/ruff.yml.
